scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship
other_conditions: Candidates must be Indian citizens or persons of Indian origin with PIO status.
Must hold a Ph.D. degree (or have submitted the thesis awaiting award) in science, mathematics, engineering, pharmacy, medicine, or agriculture‑related subjects.
Minimum 60% marks (or equivalent CGPA) throughout the academic profile from Class 12 onward.
Must have publications in highly reputed journals demonstrating outstanding research potential.
Applicants employed in regular/contractual positions in India may apply but must resign from their current job before taking up the fellowship.
Upper age limit is 32 years for general category, 37 years for SC, ST and women candidates, and 42 years for candidates with benchmark disabilities.
benefits_summary: Selected fellows receive a fellowship of ₹1,25,000 per month and an annual research grant of ₹7,00,000 for up to 5 years.
